backend/clues.mo: Defines a simple clue storage system using a Map with functions to create, retrieve, list, and delete clues while tracking incremental IDs.
backend/main.mo: Actor providing user profile management and admin-restricted clue CRUD operations with integrated authorization checks.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report placeholder with no listed features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of various frontend files in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining extensive OKLCH theme variables for light and dark modes with global background and text styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the root React app and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router with '/echofields' routes, layout, and theme provider to render the app.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component showing copyright text and a caffeine.ai attribution link with icons.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Minimal header that links back to the Echofields home route using a button.
Parses clue text for Markdown image syntax and safely renders text and validated images.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, reinitializing and invalidating queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identity, and status handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks wrapping backend clue operations such as list, get, create, and delete with error handling and invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers, color variables for light/dark themes, and intro animations including the Echofields title styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and the Internet Identity provider and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin interface for listing, creating, and deleting clues with owner‑restricted access using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/CluePage.tsx: Displays a single clue by ID with loading, error handling, navigation, and rich content rendering.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page with intro animation, description, first‑clue CTA, and feature cards using fetched clue data.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage fallback.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and theme variables for the Echofields design system.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s schema version, a high‑level summary of the Echofields app, and a list of existing features describing frontend routing, layout, pages, rendering, authentication, and backend access‑control behavior.
